## Learning Objectives

- Chain commands using the pipe (written as `|>` or `%>%`) and recognize mistakes to avoid (topic from Lecture 5)
- Review `dplyr` "verbs" we learned in Lecture 5 and learn new “verbs”
- Rename and recode variables using `rename()`, `recode()`, and `case_when()`
- Identify syntactic vs. non-syntactic variable names and handle them correctly


## Before Class

- Review Lecture 5 materials and the basics of `dplyr`
